integrity: The complete zero-indicator locus and error supremum are established by exact algebra and a convergent positive-coefficient proof; numerical checks are supplementary. Publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Exactly converged two-stage right-Radau collocation, logistic scalar equation, the specified node-deletion indicator and exact arithmetic; selection and convergence of a nonlinear solver are not established. The sharp \(3/4\) bound is an absolute one-step value in unit-carrying-capacity normalization.
title: Exact blind locus of a Radau node-deletion error estimator on logistic growth
